mapper.sql: select s.id, s.device_id, s.device_code, s.serial_number, s.model, s.firmware_version, s.status, s.created_at, s.last_seen_at, b.id binding_id, b.bed_id, b.bound_at, d.serial_number bed_sn, u.id user_id, u.nickname user_name, u.phone user_phone, l.boot_id, l.sequence_number, l.repetition_count, l.moving, l.standby, l.sensor_ok, l.received_at, l.schema_version, l.training_state, case when s.status <> 'ACTIVE' then 'DISABLED' when l.sensor_id is null then 'WAITING' when l.standby = 1 then 'STANDBY' when l.received_at <= utc_timestamp(3) - interval 90 second then 'OFFLINE' when l.sensor_ok = 0 then 'ERROR' when l.training_state = 'paused' then 'PAUSED' when l.moving = 1 then 'MOVING' else 'STILL' end state from sensor_devices s left join sensor_device_bindings b on b.sensor_id = s.id and b.unbound_at is null left join devices d on d.id = b.bed_id left join user_device_selections own on own.device_id = b.bed_id left join users u on u.id = own.user_id left join sensor_latest_readings l on l.sensor_id = s.id

where.if: and concat_ws(' ', device_id, device_code, bed_sn, user_name, user_phone, user_id) like #{filter.pattern} escape '!'

mapper.select:
select * from () sensors
order by id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
mapper.sql: from sensor_device_bindings b left join devices d on d.id = b.bed_id left join users u on u.id = b.user_id where b.sensor_id = #{sensorId}
mapper.select:
select b.id, b.sensor_id, b.bed_id, b.user_id, b.bound_at, b.unbound_at, d.serial_number bed_sn, u.nickname user_name, u.phone user_phone
order by b.id desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
mapper.sql: w.id, w.sensor_id, w.bed_id, w.user_id, w.boot_id, w.started_at, w.last_motion_at, w.ended_at, w.start_count, w.end_count, w.status, w.end_reason, w.schema_version, w.device_session_id, w.binding_id, w.active_duration_ms, w.training_state, w.time_valid, w.time_quality, w.ownership_status, w.start_uptime_ms, w.end_uptime_ms, w.average_period_ms, w.min_period_ms, w.max_period_ms, w.summary_received, w.last_received_at, estimated_calories, calorie_weight_kg, calorie_weight_defaulted, s.device_id, s.device_code, d.serial_number bed_sn, u.nickname user_name, u.phone user_phone
from sensor_workout_sessions w join sensor_devices s on s.id = w.sensor_id left join devices d on d.id = w.bed_id left join users u on u.id = w.user_id

where.if: and concat_ws(' ', s.device_id, s.device_code, d.serial_number, u.nickname, u.phone, w.user_id) like #{filter.pattern} escape '!'

mapper.select: select coalesce(sum(greatest(0, w.end_count - w.start_count)), 0) repetitions, coalesce(sum( case when then else 0 end ), 0) duration_ms, coalesce(sum(case when w.status = 'ACTIVE' then 1 else 0 end), 0) active_sessions, coalesce(sum(), 0.0) estimated_calories, coalesce(sum( case when w.time_valid = 1 and w.started_at >= #{dayStart} and w.started_at < #{dayEnd} then else 0.0 end ), 0.0) today_estimated_calories
select id from sensor_devices where id = #{id} for update
mapper.update: update sensor_workout_sessions set status = 'COMPLETED', training_state = 'idle', ended_at = last_motion_at, end_reason = #{reason} where sensor_id = #{sensorId} and status = 'ACTIVE'
